'''Ludwig Mehlhorn''' (5 January 1950 in [[Bernsbach]] – 3 May 2011 in [[Berlin]]) was a German mathematician.<ref>{{cite web | url = http://www.chronik-der-wende.de/lexikon/biografien/biographie_jsp/key=mehlhorn_ludwig.html| title = Chronik-Biographie: Ludwig Mehlorn| accessdate = 14 November 2013 | language = German}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url = http://www.eaberlin.de/5650D92E809141509B714F6DC040174C.php | title = "Wir müssen konkret werden." - Verständigung zwischen Deutschen und Polen im Sinne von Ludwig Mehlhorn | accessdate = 14 November 2013 | language = German | author = Karoline Lehmann | date = May 3, 2012 | publisher = Evangelische Akademie zu Berlin | url-status = dead | archiveurl = https://archive.today/20131114140119/http://www.eaberlin.de/5650D92E809141509B714F6DC040174C.php | archivedate = 14 November 2013 }}</ref>
